programme.desc: S04 E08 — I Was En Vogue's Love Slave Music trio En Vogue sues Marlon after he sells an innocent picture of the group to a tabloid magazine.
programme.title: The Wayans Bros.

programme.desc: S04 E09 — Can I Get a Witness? Marlon (Marlon Wayans) witnesses a bank robbery and his cooperation with the police puts him in danger. With Shawn Wayans and John Witherspoon.
programme.title: The Wayans Bros.

programme.desc: S04 E10 — Ted's Revenge A former co-worker (guest star Jack Plotnick), now an Internal Revenue Service agent, threatens Shawn (Shawn Wayans).
programme.title: The Wayans Bros.

programme.desc: S04 E11 — All in the Family Feud Marlon's letter-writing campaign gets the Williams family on a TV game show, but Shawn thinks Marlon should stay home.
programme.title: The Wayans Bros.

programme.desc: S04 E12 — Raging Marlon Marlon (Marlon Wayans) accidentally challenges a boxing champion (guest star Hector "Macho" Camacho) to a fight.
programme.title: The Wayans Bros.

programme.desc: S04 E13 — The Son of Marlon Marlon (Marlon Wayans) begins dating a single mother (guest star Kent Masters-King) and finds he has a lot in common with her 7-year-old son (guest star Jeremy Suarez).
programme.title: The Wayans Bros.

programme.desc: S04 E14 — Dee's Dee-lemma Shawn and Marlon (Shawn and Marlon Wayans) take Dee's (Anna Maria Horsford) new boyfriend (guest star Richard Whiten) out for a night on the town.
programme.title: The Wayans Bros.

programme.desc: S04 E15 — Independence Day Marlon is tricked into signing a lease for a tenement apartment, then asks Shawn to help him get out of it.
programme.title: The Wayans Bros.

programme.desc: S04 E16 — Help a Brother Out Marlon's (Marlon Wayans) research for an audition leads to a homeless man (guest star Lawrence Hilton-Jacobs) moving in with him.
programme.title: The Wayans Bros.

programme.desc: S04 E17 — The Rich Girl Shawn (Shawn Wayans) worries that Pops (John Witherspoon) will embarrass him when he meets his rich girlfriend's father (guest star Tucker Smallwood).
programme.title: The Wayans Bros.

programme.desc: S04 E18 — Busta Saves the Day Rapper Busta Rhymes (as himself) saves the day after Marlon and Shawn (Marlon Wayans, Shawn Wayans) lose money for Dee's (Anna Maria Horsford) church benefit.
programme.title: The Wayans Bros.

programme.desc: S04 E19 — Talk Is Cheap Shawn and Marlon (Shawn Wayans, Marlon Wayans) go on "The Jerry Springer Show" and end up battling over Marlon's girlfriend (guest star Adriane Kelly). Jerry Springer also guest stars.
programme.title: The Wayans Bros.

programme.desc: S04 E20 — Bringing It All Back Home Shawn and Marlon (Shawn Wayans, Marlon Wayans) plot to keep Pops (John Witherspoon) from selling the family home by making it less marketable.
programme.title: The Wayans Bros.

programme.desc: S04 E21 — Recipe for Success Pops (John Witherspoon) shows off his chili at a food festival, but he doesn't know its secret ingredient: dog food.
programme.title: The Wayans Bros.

programme.desc: S02 E10 — Traffic School Daze Jamie and Braxton (Jamie Foxx, Christopher B. Duncan) must endure the rigors of a tough driving school and its hard-nosed officer (guest star Mark Curry).
programme.title: The Jamie Foxx Show

programme.desc: S02 E11 — Too Much Soul Food Jamie (Jamie Foxx) takes a reluctant Junior (Garrett Morris) to the hospital where he faces a serious diagnosis.
programme.title: The Jamie Foxx Show

programme.desc: S02 E12 — Super Face/Off A case of mistaken identity leaves Jamie the leader of a dangerous gang, and the gang leader posing as Jamie.
programme.title: The Jamie Foxx Show

programme.desc: S02 E13 — Soul Mate to Cellmate Jamie (Jamie Foxx) gets a surprise when he dates another woman (guest star Tichina Arnold) to make Fancy (Garcelle Beauvais) jealous.
programme.title: The Jamie Foxx Show

programme.desc: S02 E14 — Papa Don't Preach Jamie asks a gospel singer to join his new rock band, provoking the ire of the singer's minister father.
programme.title: The Jamie Foxx Show

programme.desc: S02 E15 — Convent-ional Gifts Jamie accidentally switches a sexy gag gift for Braxton with a religious statue intended for a parochial schoolteacher.
programme.title: The Jamie Foxx Show

programme.desc: S02 E16 — Passenger 187 Jamie and Braxton (Jamie Foxx, Christopher B. Duncan) must land a plane after a medical emergency sidelines the aircraft's pilot.
programme.title: The Jamie Foxx Show

programme.desc: S02 E17 — Ain't Nothin' Happenin' Cap'n Fancy finally accepts Jamie's advances, leaving him shocked; Braxton employs pop psychology in an effort to understand women.
programme.title: The Jamie Foxx Show

programme.desc: S02 E18 — It's All Good, Fellas Jamie (Jamie Foxx) saves the life of a mobster (guest star Eddie Mekka), who then lavishes him with gifts.
programme.title: The Jamie Foxx Show

programme.desc: S02 E19 — You Ain't Gotta Go Home, But ... Jamie is evicted from King's Tower after throwing one too many loud parties and ends up as Braxton's roommate.
programme.title: The Jamie Foxx Show

programme.desc: S02 E21 — I'm Too Sexy for This Shot Jamie seeks legal advice from a tough lawyer after revealing photos of Fancy turn up on the Internet.
programme.title: The Jamie Foxx Show

programme.desc: S02 E22 — How Jamie Got His Groove Jamie (Jamie Foxx) meets K-Ci & Jojo (guest starring as themselves) and gives them a copy of his demo tape on a chance for his big break.
programme.title: The Jamie Foxx Show

programme.desc: S03 E01 — Jamie Returns Jamie (Jamie Foxx) goes on tour, performing before thousands of fans; Fancy (Garcelle Beauvais) has a new boyfriend.
programme.title: The Jamie Foxx Show

programme.desc: S03 E02 — Don't Hate the Player, Hate the Game Jamie (Jamie Foxx) plots to have Fancy's (Garcelle Beauvais) new boyfriend, Silas (guest star Alan F. Smith), get caught in a compromising situation.
programme.title: The Jamie Foxx Show

programme.desc: S03 E03 — MEN-O-pause Junior (Garrett Morris) is chagrined when a slim Helen (Ellia English) starts getting attention from men.
programme.title: The Jamie Foxx Show

programme.desc: S03 E04 — Swing Out Sister Jamie's fortune-seeking sister may find the wrong kind of fame when she gets invited to a wild party.
programme.title: The Jamie Foxx Show

programme.title: The Jamie Foxx Show

programme.desc: S03 E06 — Guess Who's Not Coming to Dinner Braxton's (Christopher B. Duncan) secret relationship with Cameron (Susan Wood) causes trouble when an old flame (guest star Tembi Locke) comes to town.
programme.title: The Jamie Foxx Show

programme.desc: S41 E13 — They Are Like Cockroaches The challengers are sent on the heist of a century to collect a key using… haystacks. This exhausting challenge is a crucial look into everyone's speed and endurance, and one team's performance is shocking to everyone.
programme.title: The Challenge

programme.desc: S41 E14 — We Have to Boogie! As the numbers whittle down, everyone's collective performance in the challenge becomes crucial because winning or losing takes a vote away from their alliance; how important is your own safety versus your team's safety?
programme.title: The Challenge

programme.desc: S41 E15 — The Best Birthday Present In a challenge filled with chains, the players must trust their partner's driving skills to help them succeed; if you love rummaging through your junk drawer and unraveling cable, this elimination won't be one to miss.
programme.title: The Challenge

programme.desc: S41 E16 — Am I Being Bamboozled? The challengers must navigate a harrowing and pitch-black cave in hopes of earning safety; the teams in elimination must cram into a replica airplane bathroom, and it's not even close to the mile high club.
programme.title: The Challenge

programme.desc: S41 E17 — Ten Toes Down An argument creates tension in the house and reveals who's been playing honest and how devious the game can really be; a headbanger awaits the teams in elimination, and it's more than just their life in the game.
programme.title: The Challenge

programme.desc: S41 E18 — Finale Part I After a grueling season, the final four teams have made it to TJ's Final; while battling exhaustion, the players must complete grueling runs, mind-numbing checkpoints and the ultimate temptation to become Challenge Champions; that's only day one.
programme.title: The Challenge

programme.desc: S12 E01 — The Ink Will Speak for Itself Eighteen artists arrive ready to fight for themselves but instead find they must work in teams divided by gender; battle lines are drawn, then tested, in the "Ink Master" Battle of the Sexes; in the end, only one will win $100,000.
programme.title: Ink Master

programme.desc: S12 E02 — A Storm Is Brewin' Team leaders emerge in a shocking new season-long twist that sends the Artists a wake-up call and shakes up the competition; The Battle of the Sexes continues for $100K and the title of Ink Master.
programme.title: Ink Master

programme.desc: S12 E03 — Down to the Wire The artists must fight even harder to win the Battle of the Sexes as the field thins and the competition intensifies; one artist is not wired properly for the competition and must pack up and close shop.
programme.title: Ink Master

programme.desc: S12 E04 — The Hunter & the Hunted The judges are looking for color contrast and the artists are out for blood with full color neo-traditional animal tattoos.
programme.title: Ink Master

programme.desc: S12 E05 — The Art Stands Alone It's every man or woman for themselves when the artists are subject to a blind critique.
programme.title: Ink Master

programme.title: Boundless
programme.desc: Adventure junkies Simon Donato and Paul "Turbo" Trebilcock try to prove that boundaries are meant to be broken as they test their limits in some of the world's toughest endurance races. Donato, who holds a doctorate in geology, is the brains of the duo and a self-proclaimed nomad. Trebilcock, a dedicated athlete with a background in running, is considered the heart of the team. Together, they participate in competitions that include a seven-day race through volcanic terrain in Iceland, a 46-mile foot race with obstacles, and a 142-mile run through Cambodian jungles. From running, biking, skiing, swimming and climbing, their love for the rush coupled with their undeniable stamina makes it a wild ride with a few cuts and bruised egos along the way. Endurance athletes Rory Bosio and Hunter McIntyre join the team beginning in Season 3.

Together, they participate in competitions that include a seven-day race through volcanic terrain in Iceland, a 46-mile foot race with obstacles, and a 142-mile run through Cambodian jungles. From running, biking, skiing, swimming and climbing, their love for the rush coupled with their undeniable stamina makes it a wild ride with a few cuts and bruised egos along the way. Endurance athletes Rory Bosio and Hunter McIntyre join the team beginning in Season 3.

programme.title: Password
programme.desc: Starring Jimmy Fallon and hosted by Keke Palmer, the iconic word-guessing game features celebrities teaming up with everyday contestants. These teams play a modern and refreshed version of the game that's inspired by classic Password, Password Plus, Super Password and the viral celebrity Password games seen on The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon. Players compete over three rounds of gameplay, taking turns trying to get their partner to guess the password using one-word clues. The team with the most points after two rounds heads to the bonus round, where they have 60 seconds to get the celebrity guests to correctly guess 10 passwords for a chance to win as much as $25,000.

Twenty-six years later, two children find the game in their attic, and when they start to play, Alan is released, but the game isn't over yet, and Alan must finish before he is really free.
programme.title: Jumanji

programme.desc: Four teens embark on the adventure of a lifetime when a video game magically transports them to the jungle and transforms them into adults.
programme.title: Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle

programme.desc: When Spencer goes back into the fantastical world of Jumanji, pals Martha, Fridge and Bethany re-enter the game to bring him home. But everything about Jumanji is about to change, as they soon discover more obstacles and more danger to overcome.
programme.title: Jumanji: The Next Level

programme.desc: Peter Rabbit and his three sisters -- Flopsy, Mopsy and Cotton-Tail -- enjoy spending their days in Mr. McGregor's vegetable garden. When one of McGregor's relatives suddenly moves in, he's less than thrilled to discover a family of rabbits in his new home. A battle of wills soon breaks out as the new owner hatches scheme after scheme to get rid of Peter -- a resourceful rabbit who proves to be a worthy and wily opponent.
programme.title: Peter Rabbit

programme.desc: Matilda is a gifted child, more gifted than any other, but her parents won't let her go to school. She teaches herself for years by going to the library and reading everything she sees. Eventually she convinces her parents to let her go to school, but discovers her special talents are needed to protect the school and her lovely teacher from the evil headmistress.
programme.title: Matilda

programme.desc: A wisecracking toddler deals with toilet training, bickering parents and a baby sister in this sequel to the 1989 hit.
programme.title: Look Who's Talking Too

programme.desc: When Gabby's dollhouse, her most prized possession, ends up in the hands of an eccentric cat lady named Vera, she sets off on an adventure through the real world to get the Gabby Cats back together before it's too late.
programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse: The Movie

programme.desc: Yogi, Boo Boo, and Ranger Smith team up to try to stop the mayor from closing Jellystone Park and selling it to loggers.
programme.title: Yogi Bear

programme.desc: A young kid teams up with the niece of young adult horror author RL Stine after the writer's imaginary demons are set free on the town of Greendale, Maryland.
programme.title: Goosebumps

programme.desc: Best friends meet, a mischievous dummy who brings his ghoulish friends back to life, just in time for Halloween. As the town becomes overrun with monsters, the boys join forces to save the town from Slappy's wicked plan.
programme.title: Goosebumps 2

programme.desc: Demonised as the Wicked Witch of the West, Elphaba lives in exile, while Glinda resides at the palace in Emerald City. As an angry mob rises against the Wicked Witch, she'll need to reunite with Glinda to transform herself, and all of Oz, for good.
programme.title: Wicked: For Good

programme.desc: A mysterious portal pulls four misfits into the Overworld, a bizarre, cubic wonderland that thrives on imagination. To get back home, they'll have to master the terrain while embarking on a magical quest with an unexpected crafter named Steve.
programme.title: A Minecraft Movie

programme.desc: Spoof spy caper with the eponymous, blundering hero attempting to recover the crown jewels and save Britain from an evil mastermind when all the other agents are killed. Promoted from lowly pen pusher to super spy, Johnny English is baffled when clues lead to respected entrepreneur Pascal Sauvage, but could the enigmatic Lorna hold the key to the mystery?
programme.title: Johnny English

programme.desc: Mr Bean has somehow managed to get a job as a security guard. His latest assignment finds him travelling to America as an art expert, looking after the famous 'Whistler's Mother' painting as it is transported from Britain to a posh new Los Angeles museum. The catch is that Bean is no art expert and his trip was a ploy by his British employers to get rid of him. Unfortunately, no one has warned the Americans about Mr Bean.
programme.title: Bean: The Ultimate Disaster Movie

programme.desc: Mr Bean is going on holiday to the south of France, looking for a quiet and sunny trip in the Riviera. However, his trip doesn't go as smoothly as he expected when he has to face a series of misunderstandings and totally unfortunate coincidences. Eventually, Mr Bean will end up spoiling the last film of the snobbish director Carson Clay and appearing by accident at the Cannes Film Festival.
programme.title: Mr Bean's Holiday

programme.desc: Demonised as the Wicked Witch of the West, Elphaba lives in exile, while Glinda resides at the palace in Emerald City. As an angry mob rises against the Wicked Witch, she'll need to reunite with Glinda to transform herself, and all of Oz, for good.
programme.title: Wicked: For Good

programme.desc: An unconventional sleuth attempts to find a football team's stolen mascot dolphin. The Miami Dolphins are aghast when their beloved Snowflake is abducted one week before the all-important Super Bowl, so they call in Ace Ventura, a private eye who uses unorthodox methods to retrieve missing animals.
programme.title: Ace Ventura: Pet Detective

programme.desc: Legendary pet detective Ace Ventura returns for another adventure when he's coerced out of retirement while on a soul-searching retreat in the Himalayas. He must now retrieve an endangered white bat from a village located in Africa. The sacred animal was offered up as a wedding dowry from the Wachootoo prince to the Wachati princess, and, if Ace can't track down the culprit behind the kidnapping in time, civil war will break out between the two rival tribes.
programme.title: Ace Ventura: When Nature Calls

programme.desc: A pair of idiotic friends set off on a madcap journey to return a briefcase to its owner. However, they are blissfully unaware that the case contains a large amount of ransom money for the owner's kidnapped husband. Their trip is soon fraught with disaster, especially when the kidnappers begin to pursue them across the country with the aim of grabbing the cash.
programme.title: Dumb & Dumber

programme.desc: A normally well-behaved teenager goes wild while his parents are out of town. In charge at his parents' smart house, the 17-year-old sees the chance to make a fast buck when the prostitute, on the run from a scary pimp, appears at his door. He takes her in, and, following his school's entrepreneurial teachings, lets her turn the house into a brothel.
programme.title: Risky Business

programme.desc: Sporting billionaire brothers reverse the roles of a Wall Street commodities broker and a street hustler.
programme.title: Trading Places

programme.desc: When the transition is being made from silent films to `talkies', everyone has trouble adapting. Don and Lina have been cast repeatedly as a romantic couple, but when their latest film is remade into a musical, only Don has the voice for the new singing part. After a lot of practise with a diction coach, Lina still sounds terrible, and Kathy, a bright young aspiring actress, is hired to record over her voice.
programme.title: Singin' in the Rain

programme.desc: Oct 2026 Previews of the great films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky.
programme.title: Sky Cinema Preview

programme.desc: A lonely poet who's unlucky in love believes he's struck gold when he meets Harriet, an attractive, witty woman who owns a butcher's shop. They fall in love and marry, but a series of strange occurrences lead him to suspect that his new wife may be harbouring a dark and deadly secret.
programme.title: So I Married an Axe Murderer

programme.desc: A womanising New York marketing man meets his match in his new boss. After initially spurning his advances, she ultimately gives him a taste of his own medicine.
programme.title: Boomerang

programme.desc: An out-of-work actor dresses in drag for an audition, only to land the female lead in a TV soap. When he becomes the most popular character on the show, he feels compelled to carry the persona into his everyday life. While bringing him phenomenal success as an `actress', life as a woman also has its problems - especially when he falls for an actress with whom he works.

All goes well for the Bandit as he drives from Texas to Georgia with a truckload of illicit beer until he stops to pick up a damsel in distress, who also happens to be the sheriff's daughter.

The girl harbours the secret belief that she is responsible for her mother's death in childbirth, and is troubled by her father's new relationship with a beautician at his funeral parlour. Adapted from 'The Body', a novella by Stephen King.

programme.desc: A Secret Service agent-turned-bodyguard finds danger and romance while protecting an entertainer from a stalker.
programme.title: The Bodyguard

programme.desc: Paul Edgecomb, the head guard of death row, just wants life for him, his colleagues and the condemned to be nice and easy. However, when John Coffey, a massive man convicted of brutally killing a pair of young sisters, arrives, things start to get strange. Beyond his simple, naïve nature and a deathly fear of the dark, Coffey seems to possess a prodigious, supernatural gift. Paul begins to question whether Coffey was truly guilty of murdering the two girls.
programme.title: The Green Mile

programme.desc: With his strict father's guidance, Tre manages to stay clear of drugs and violence. However, as gang violence begin to invade his neighbourhood, it becomes almost impossible for him and his friends to avoid being dragged under.
programme.title: Boyz N the Hood

programme.desc: In 1977 London, the world of two pirate DJs gets turned upside down when their gay friend is murdered before one of them discovers they are in possession of a tape recording of the killing.
programme.title: Young Soul Rebels

programme.desc: As war rages over London, neighbours Maurice Bendrix and Sarah Miles fall in love and begin a relationship. Unfortunately Sarah is married to Henry, a colleague of the American Maurice, who confides in him that he thinks his wife is cheating on him.
programme.title: The End of the Affair

programme.desc: Sweeping epic about three sons raised on a Montana ranch by their father, a colonel who has turned his back on the army after the Indian Wars. Though the destinies of the boys are very different, two forces impact on each of their lives: the Great War in Europe and the love of a young woman. Covering several decades, the action ranges from majestic Montana to the battlefields of Europe and adventure on the high seas.
programme.title: Legends of the Fall

programme.desc: When petty criminal Luke Jackson is sentenced to two years in a Florida prison farm, he doesn't play by the rules of either the sadistic warden or the yard's resident heavy, Dragline, who ends up admiring the new guy's unbreakable will. Luke's bravado, even in the face of repeated stints in the prison's dreaded solitary confinement cell, 'the box' makes him a rebel hero to his fellow convicts and a thorn in the side of the prison officers.
programme.title: Cool Hand Luke

programme.desc: Andy Dufresne and Ellis Boyd 'Red' Redding are two prisoners serving long sentences in the vicious Shawshank jail. The two come to terms with their imprisonment while surviving the sadistic acts of prison warden Samuel Norton, and for both, a different sort of redemption awaits.
programme.title: The Shawshank Redemption

programme.desc: Vietnam veteran John J Rambo is pushed too far by the sheriff of a small American town. After being wrongfully arrested, he escapes and leads lawmen and an army detachment on a chase through the mountains.
programme.title: First Blood

programme.desc: War veteran John Rambo takes on the entire Vietnamese army, plus Soviet advisers, when he is released from prison and sent back to present-day Vietnam in search of American prisoners of war still being held in enemy custody.
programme.title: Rambo: First Blood Part II

programme.desc: Reluctant one-man army Rambo goes into action against brutal Soviet invaders in Afghanistan. Sought out in a Buddhist monastery retreat, Rambo declines his former commander's request for help to deliver missiles to the mujahideen, but when his superior is captured and imprisoned, the hulking hero brings out the big guns.
programme.title: Rambo III

programme.desc: This edition of The Cinema List is about being trapped. From the depths of the ocean in '47 Meters Down' to the vastness of space in 'Gravity', getting out is easier said than done.
programme.title: The Cinema List: Trapped

programme.desc: Young Jim has to grow up fast after the Japanese invade Shanghai. Separated from his parents and alone in a prisoner of war camp, Jim must fight to survive.
programme.title: Empire of the Sun

programme.desc: Stanley Kubrick's take on the Vietnam War follows smart-aleck Private Davis, quickly christened 'Joker' by his foul-mouthed drill sergeant, and pudgy Private Lawrence, nicknamed 'Gomer Pyle', as they endure the rigours of basic training. Though Pyle takes a frightening detour, Joker graduates to the Marine Corps and is sent to Vietnam as a journalist, covering, and eventually participating in, the Battle of Hue.
programme.title: Full Metal Jacket

programme.desc: Classic Oscar-winning tough comedy adventure set in First World War Africa featuring a hard-drinking, woman-hating owner of the 'African Queen', a decrepit steamer that trades up and down the river, and a strait-laced spinster sister of missionary Rev Samuel Sayer, whom he has agreed to take back to civilisation.
programme.title: The African Queen

programme.desc: A teenage girl wants revenge on the man who killed her father, but she needs help from legendary one-eyed marshal "Rooster" Cogburn, and a Texas Ranger.
programme.title: True Grit

programme.desc: In an England of the future, Alex de Large is the leader of a gang of droogs whose pastime is violence, sex and murder, but whose eventual punishment is almost as extreme and violent as his crimes. Betrayed by the other members of his gang, he is arrested and offered an experimental treatment in order to shorten his sentence.
programme.title: A Clockwork Orange

programme.desc: Detective Nick Curran is charged with finding out the truth after Catherine Tramell, a sensual bisexual writer, is suspected of murdering her lover with an ice pick, exactly the method used in one of her books. Unfortunately, he becomes too closely involved.
programme.title: Basic Instinct

programme.desc: Sinbad sails to the island of Colossa to rescue a beautiful princess from an evil sorcerer's spell. Once there, he does battle with a succession of marvellous creatures.
programme.title: The 7th Voyage of Sinbad

programme.desc: In 2274, computers rule a hermetically sealed city housing the survivors of a holocaust that has decimated the earth. Life is hedonistic and happy for the city's inhabitants; unfortunately they must be terminated when they reach 30. When Logan 5, a trained hunter for the system, grows intrigued by a beautiful young woman, he is forced to question the fundamental principles of his society and decides he must flee.
programme.title: Logan's Run

programme.desc: William Popper (Michael Sarrazin) is a wealthy, shiftless college student at Columbia who, one night in a rainstorm, accidentally kills a jaywalker with his car. Sentenced to a year in prison for manslaughter, William begins serving his term, but before it's finished he decides to break out. With the help of his faithful and politically radical girlfriend, Jane (Barbara Hershey), he skips town and escapes to Canada, where the two are obliged to live like fugitives.
programme.title: The Pursuit of Happiness

programme.desc: A teenage girl wants revenge on the man who killed her father, but she needs help from legendary one-eyed marshal "Rooster" Cogburn, and a Texas Ranger.
programme.title: True Grit

programme.desc: A man's neutrality during the American Civil War is tested by his daughter's marriage and his son's capture by Union forces.
programme.title: Shenandoah

programme.desc: On his return from the Crusades, Robin of Locksley learns that his father has been murdered by the tyrannical Sheriff of Nottingham and embarks on a campaign of guerrilla warfare to protect King Richard's throne. Fight scenes are lively and inventive, and a set piece fought under the forest canopy pulls out all the stops.
programme.title: Robin Hood: Prince of Thieves

programme.desc: Following the death of a local diver, a New York palaeontologist is sent out to help the local fisheries warden investigate the case.
programme.title: Lake Placid

programme.desc: Filmmaker Terri Flores is travelling deep in the Amazon jungle looking for a forgotten tribe. Terri and her crew, which includes an anthropologist and a cameraman, come across Paul, who is stranded on the riverbank. He offers to help them find the tribe, but his secretive behaviour puts everyone on edge. They realise too late that he's using them to find a legendary anaconda that's worth a fortune, if they can catch it.
programme.title: Anaconda

programme.desc: Scary chiller about a coastal community plagued by a killer shark. With the summer tourist season at hand, the mayor is keen to keep the first attack hushed up. However, when an expert claims that the attacks are the work of a giant great white shark, there is only one solution - to kill the monster fish before it can feed again.
programme.title: Jaws

programme.desc: Another great white shark arrives to terrorise the holiday resort of Amity Island. Having recovered from the grisly events of four years ago, the island is once again packed with tourists. Families are sailing in the bay and swimming off the beach, but when two divers and a water-skier go missing, the local police chief fears that he is about to relive his greatest nightmare.
programme.title: Jaws 2

programme.desc: Second sequel to Steven Spielberg's 1970s blockbuster transports the action from Amity Island to a new undersea kingdom attraction in a Florida theme park. The capture of a baby great white shark is big news and brings crowds to the park - until its mother arrives on the scene.
programme.title: Jaws III

programme.desc: Henry Hill knows only too well that he must put the Mob's interests before everything, even his family, but when the good times turn sour, his loyalties dissolve in the face of greater rewards. Faced with a terrible retribution, Hill can see only one way to get out alive.
programme.title: Goodfellas

programme.desc: About a failing pub, a divided community, and a grieving family whose lives are changed by brewing real ale and entering the Great British Beer Awards.
programme.title: Mother's Pride

programme.desc: Ex-fighter Joe helps run his partner Estrella's farm in Mexico. After taking underground fights to support workers, he's forced to defend himself and Marco when Chavez's gang attacks them on the road.
programme.title: Mexicali

programme.desc: Navy Seal Jake Harris must stop a team of mercenaries, led by his disillusioned former comrade, from disabling the US missile defence network.
programme.title: One Last Shot

programme.desc: A highly contagious and rapidly mutating microorganism starts to multiply as it unleashes its brain-controlling, body-bursting terrors at a former military base.
programme.title: Cold Storage

programme.desc: A man with a violent past kidnaps the boy he holds responsible for his son's death. As he grows closer to uncovering the truth, he's left to wonder whether his pursuers are really seeking to protect the boy, or merely the secrets he keeps.
programme.title: Barron's Cove

programme.desc: A rising pop star navigates the complexities of fame and industry pressure while preparing for her arena tour debut.
programme.title: The Moment

programme.desc: Matt and Jay's plan to book a show at the Rivoli goes horribly wrong, resulting in them accidentally travelling back to the year 2008.
programme.title: Nirvanna the Band the Show the Movie

programme.desc: A clever bounty-hunting pig must return a dancing elephant to a Las Vegas circus to collect $1 million. However, when the mission goes sideways, he soon realises that no amount of money is worth losing his newfound friends.
programme.title: Hitpig!

programme.desc: Two teenage cousins dig deep to find self-acceptance and a date to the Debutante Ball in a small country town in Australia.
programme.title: The Deb

programme.desc: Join David Attenborough on an adventure to learn more about some of the most unassuming creatures on the planet. Though these insects are small and often too quick for the eye to observe for long periods of time, this documentary series utilises cutting-edge camera technology to capture the hidden world of dragonflies, which have existed since the time of the dinosaurs. Step into their world and discover how beautiful these flying insects are while learning about how their behaviours are as complex as those of mammals.
programme.title: David Attenborough's Dragons and Damsels

Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
programme.desc: Rachael shows us how to make an impossibly delicious brunch menu of Parm Frittata with tomato sauce, served with a side of sausage and a simple salad that you can serve all day.

programme.title: My Market Kitchen
programme.desc: Asian chef Kinsan and Laura make Japanese Vegetable Tempura in the Market Kitchen. Laura then prepares Chicken Schnitzel with Mushroom Sauce.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Come spring, Lidia gets very excited to visit the market. The colour, the aromas, that first harvest, it all ignites her creative side to get cooking after a long winter.

programme.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn
programme.desc: Hayden dives at sunrise for sea urchins, then he's off to a local farmers' market to buy mushrooms, grab some famous donuts, and cook for his friends on their goat farm.

programme.title: Freshly Picked With Simon Toohey
programme.desc: Hot and spicy is all the rage in today's episode. Rebecca Veale is back in the kitchen for crispy chilli stir fry, and Simon brings a spicy salad loaded with mouthwatering roasted radishes.

programme.title: Jamie's Great Italian Escape
programme.desc: Jamie Oliver arrives on the tiny Sicilian island of Marettimo. Here he meets fisherman Giovanni - the owner of one of Sicily's best restaurants - who has Jamie work as his assistant in his eatery.

programme.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
programme.desc: It's a beautifully buttery night on The Cook Up, as Adam is joined by croissant connoisseur Kate Reid and acclaimed chef Giovanni Pilu.

programme.title: Symon's Dinners Cooking Out
programme.desc: This traditional Tuscan dish is perfect for a summer's late lunch to carry you into an evening of relaxing. Michael Symon revamps some grilled chicken by glazing it with some floral vermouth.

programme.title: Paula McIntyre's Hamely Kitchen
programme.desc: Paula shows us how to make her version of steak diane by substituting the steak with a collop of venision which she roasts and serves with sauteed potatoes. She demonstrates how to smoke a chicken.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Vietnam
programme.desc: Chef Luke Nguyen visits the beachside town of Nha Trang, a coastal town abundant with fresh seafood - and prepares char grilled lobster right on the beach.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Vietnam
programme.desc: Luke heads to a coastal town to teach cooking skills to disabled children, who learn how to prepare fish cakes; Luke visits to a farmyard to learn how a family creates fresh tofu; local monks demonstrate how to cook a vegetarian meal.

programme.title: Planet Bbq
programme.desc: This show gives grilled and smoked vegetables their due; tandoori cauliflower with coriander mint chutney, squash gratin with habanero chiles, and Mexican pit-roasted lamb.

programme.title: Fun'q With Spencer Watts
programme.desc: The sun is shining and Spencer is turning up the heat, cooking delicious grilled food perfect to be served on a bun. He shares his secrets to the perfect grilled veggie burger and sesame meatloaf.

programme.title: Island Echoes With Nornie Bero
programme.desc: Nornie journeys to Hammond Island to explore its unique blend of cultures and rich history.

programme.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
programme.sub-title: Grown Up Tomato Soup And Grilled Cheese
programme.desc: This classic combo from your youth gets an adult makeover and will make your mouth water. Rachael shows us her version of a creamy tomato soup and a spicy grilled cheese.

programme.title: My Market Kitchen
programme.desc: Guest chef Adam D'Sylva kicks off with his delicious Vietnamese Chicken and Bean Salad. Laura follows with Lamb and Feta Koftas with Flatbread and Yoghurt.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia always says, Let the ingredients shine! When you choose quality ingredients, it's best to let them speak for themselves.

programme.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn
programme.desc: Hayden learns about regenerative farming at a cherry farm and a cattle property, with alpacas and a famous winery visit thrown in, and ends the day with a picture-perfect campfire meal.

programme.title: Freshly Picked With Simon Toohey
programme.desc: This episode of Freshly Picked is filled with delicious sweet treats. Monica Mignone returns with her carrot cake slice. Simon makes yummy biscuits with maple and tahini.

programme.title: Jamie's Great Italian Escape
programme.desc: Jamie heads north to the mountains of Le Marche - a relatively unexplored region next door to Umbria - to stay with a family of hunters.

programme.title: The Chocolate Queen
programme.desc: Celebrated pastry chef and chocolatier Kirsten Tibballs presents an array of incredibly clever and innovative tricks, tips and cheats to bring the wow factor to home baking.

programme.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
programme.desc: Learn how to whip up Justine's delicious homemade sub or her hearty Italian ratatouille on today's episode. Also, ex-Masterchef contestant, Emelia Jackson, drops in.

programme.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
programme.desc: Two trailblazing guests, chef Analiese Gregory and hospitality head honcho Ibby Moubadder join Adam in the kitchen to celebrate the power of some simple sides.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
programme.desc: Rick journeys through southern England. He takes in the rather pungent Garlic festival on the Isle of Wight, visits a chilli fiesta, and tastes the once extinct Blue Vinny cheese.

programme.title: Nigellissima
programme.desc: Nigella shares her culinary talent as she presents delicious Italian-inspired food. First, Nigella reveals a secret passion for one of the tastes of Italy with her dark and deviant liquorice pudding.

programme.title: Matt Preston's Plating Locally
programme.desc: In the iconic Barossa, among some of the world's oldest vines, Matt celebrates the region's wine heritage, drops into Adelaide's Cheesefest and meets a world class butter maker.

programme.title: Donal's Irish Adventure
programme.desc: Donal and Max are steering their way to the Ancient East, a land of myths and legends and food traditions but first up Donal takes to the sky to battle a great fear of heights at Carlingford Adventure.

programme.title: Come Dine With Me
programme.desc: It's the final night of the competition in Bolton, where loudmouth Financial Advisor Louis is hoping his fancy menu can trump all others'.
